title: Fatigue

rationale.Dialysis (if AEIOU indications): AEIOU: Acidosis, Electrolytes, Intoxication, Overload, Uremia.

hpi: {{patient_name}} presents with progressive fatigue, weakness, anorexia, nausea, pruritus, edema, and oliguria. Labs: markedly elevated BUN/Cr, hyperkalemia, metabolic acidosis, anemia (low EPO), hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, secondary hyperparathyroidism. ESRD is irreversible loss of renal function (GFR <15). Most common causes: diabetes, hypertension, glomerulonephritis. Management: renal replacement therapy — hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, or kidney transplant. Urgent indications for dialysis: AEIOU — Acidosis, Electrolytes (hyperkalemia), Intoxication (toxins), Overload (volume), Uremia (pericarditis, encephalopathy). Treat anemia (EPO), manage mineral bone disease (phosphate binders, vitamin D, calcimimetics). Refer for AV fistula creation. Nephrology referral.
